description_en: Restarts an application. This operation is suitable for applications that are deployed on Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances
name: RestartApplication

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。可以通过调用ListApplication接口获取，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the elastic compute container (ECC) that corresponds to the ECS instance on which you want to restart the application. You can call the QueryApplicationStatus operation to query the ECC ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html.

Separate multiple ECC IDs with commas (,).
If you leave this parameter empty, the application will be restarted on all the ECS instances deployed with the application
parameters.help_zh:
应用中需要重启的ECS实例的EccId。可以通过调用QueryApplicationStatus接口获取EccId，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149394.html。
如果包含多个EccId，用半角逗号（,）分隔。
不设置该参数，表示重启该应用中的所有实例
parameters.name: ecc_info

ChangeOrderId.description_en:
The ID of the change process.

You can call the GetChangeOrderInfo operation to query the progress of this restart. For more information, see [GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html）
ChangeOrderId.description_zh:
变更流程ID。

可以调用GetChangeOrderInfo接口查询此次重启的详细执行进展，具体操作，请参见[GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html）

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
